name: KELT-10

quotes.title: KELT-10
quotes.card: KELT-10, also known as CD−47°12635, is a sun-like star in the southern constellation Telescopium.
quotes.introduction: It has an apparent magnitude of 10.62, making it readily visible in telescopes, but not to the naked eye.
